'''Heino Finkelmann''' (born 1945<ref name=uni-freiburg.de>{{cite web |url=http://www.chemie.uni-freiburg.de/makro/finkelmann/mitarbeiter/cv.htm |title=Lebenslauf Prof. Dr. Heino Finkelmann |website=chemie.uni-freiburg.de |publisher=Universität Freiburg |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060831150605/http://www.chemie.uni-freiburg.de/makro/finkelmann/mitarbeiter/cv.htm |archive-date=31 August 2006 |date= 10 March 2006 |access-date=13 July 2019 |language=de |trans-title=CV Prof. Dr. Heino Finkelmann |url-status=dead}}</ref>) is a German [[chemist]] who works with liquid-crystalline [[elastomer]]s.<ref name=kürschner />

==Biography==
After earning an engineering degree, Finkelmann graduated 1972 as chemist (Diplom) from [[Technische Universität Berlin]].<ref name=uni-freiburg.de /> In 1975, he earned his PhD at the [[Paderborn University]] under the supervision of [[Horst Stegemeyer]] in [[Physical Chemistry]].<ref name="cv">{{cite web|url=http://www.chemie.uni-freiburg.de/makro/finkelmann/mitarbeiter/cv_e.htm |archive-url=https://archive.today/20040703222502/http://www.chemie.uni-freiburg.de/makro/finkelmann/mitarbeiter/cv_e.htm |url-status=dead |archive-date=3 July 2004 |title=Curriculum Vitae Prof. Dr. Heino Finkelmann |access-date=21 July 2009 }}</ref><ref name=uni-freiburg.de />

After three years of Postdoc under the guidance of [[Helmut Ringsdorf]] at the [[Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz]], Finkelmann habilitated from 1978 to 1984 at the [[Clausthal University of Technology]] with the group of [[Günther Rehage]] in Physical Chemistry.<ref name=uni-freiburg.de />

From 1984 to 2010, Finkelmann was appointed Full Professor and Director of the Institute for Macromolecular Chemistry at the [[Albert Ludwig University of Freiburg]].<ref name=uni-freiburg.de /><ref name="unileben02/2010">{{cite journal |year=2010 |title=uni'leben, die Zeitung der Universität Freiburg |journal=Freiburger Uni-Magazin |url=https://www.pr.uni-freiburg.de/publikationen/unileben/unileben-archiv/uni-leben-und-uni-magazin-vor-2015/uni-freiburg-uni-leben-2-2010.pdf |language=de |publisher=Albert-Ludwigs-Universität Freiburg, der Rektor, Prof. Dr. Hans-Jochen Schiewer |publication-date=2010 |page=11 |issn=0947-1251 |access-date=13 July 2019 |archive-date=20 September 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200920221336/https://www.pr.uni-freiburg.de/publikationen/unileben/unileben-archiv/uni-leben-und-uni-magazin-vor-2015/uni-freiburg-uni-leben-2-2010.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="DOI10.1002/macp.200900669" />

One of his famous works is the concept of the side chain nematic elastomers.<ref>Mark Warner, Eugene Michael Terentjev,''Liquid Crystal Elastomers'', [[Oxford University Press]], 2007. {{ISBN|978-0-19-852767-1}} (Hbk.), {{ISBN|978-0-19-921486-0}} (Pbk.) p. 126</ref>
==Honours, decorations, awards and distinctions==
* 1984: [[Carl Duisberg Memorial Prize]] from the [[Society of German Chemists]]<ref name="DOI10.1002/macp.200900669">{{cite journal | last=Komp | first=Ansgar | last2=Sanchez-Ferrer | first2=Antoni | last3=Severing | first3=Kirsten | title=Heino Finkelmann: 65 Years of Devotion to Science | journal=Macromolecular Chemistry and Physics | publisher=Wiley | volume=211 | issue=3 | date=29 December 2009 | issn=1022-1352 | doi=10.1002/macp.200900669 | pages=373–374}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.gdch.de/gdch/preise-und-auszeichnungen/gdch-preise.html |title=GDCh-Preise - Carl-Duisberg-Gedächtnispreis |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=10 July 2019 |website=gdch.de |publisher=Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker e.V. (GDCh) / German Chemical Society |access-date=13 July 2019 |language=de |archive-date=13 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190713152701/https://www.gdch.de/gdch/preise-und-auszeichnungen/gdch-preise.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
* 2000: [[Gay-Lussac Humboldt Prize]]<ref name="DOI10.1002/macp.200900669" />
* 2003: [[EPS Europhysics Prize|Agilent Technologies Europhysics Prize]] of the [[European Physical Society]]<ref name="DOI10.1002/macp.200900669" />
* 2004: Doctor Honoris Causa by the [[University of Toulouse]]<ref name="DOI10.1002/macp.200900669" /><ref>{{cite journal |url=https://www.pr.uni-freiburg.de/publikationen/unileben/unileben-archiv/uni-leben-und-uni-magazin-vor-2015/uni-freiburg-uni-magazin-5-2004.pdf |title=Freiburger Unimagazin – ALBERT-LUDWIGS-UNIVERSITÄT FREIBURG |journal=Freiburger Uni-Magazin |date=5 October 2004 |editor=Albert-Ludwigs-Universität Freiburg |publisher=Promo Verlag GmbH |location=Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany |page=18 |language=de |issn=0947-1251 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180211225058/https://www.pr.uni-freiburg.de/publikationen/unileben/unileben-archiv/uni-leben-und-uni-magazin-vor-2015/uni-freiburg-uni-magazin-5-2004.pdf |archive-date=11 February 2018 |access-date=11 February 2018}}</ref>
* 2006: [[George William Gray Medal]] of the [[British Liquid Crystal Society]]<ref name=blcs>{{cite web |url=http://blcs.eng.cam.ac.uk/?page_id=55 |title=Gray Medal |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2019 |website=blcs.eng.cam.ac.uk |publisher=British Liquid Crystal Society |access-date=13 July 2019 |archive-date=13 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190713132209/http://blcs.eng.cam.ac.uk/?page_id=55 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="DOI10.1002/macp.200900669" /><ref name=kürschner>{{cite web |url=https://www.degruyter.com/view/KDGO/P27612 |title=Heino Finkelmann |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=degruyter.com |publisher=Kürschners Deutscher Gelehrten-Kalender Online |access-date=13 July 2019 |language=de |archive-date=13 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190713154428/https://www.degruyter.com/view/KDGO/P27612 |url-status=live }}</ref>
